goal: Prove bounded Rust-owned CUDA model-residency handles through pinned cuda-oxide without claiming complete model-map, kernel, or route ownership.

rust_owned_in_this_stage: managed model-window allocation with read-mostly advice
managed model-window preferred-device prefetch and stream attachment
mapped host model-window allocation with device-visible pointer
registered caller-owned model-window lifetime with device-visible pointer
not_claimed_in_this_stage: complete GGUF mapping or model-range cache ownership
model file descriptor or direct-I/O ownership
managed KV policy, quality mode, or memory reporting
DS4 compute kernels or tensor fill kernel
runtime graph or default CUDA route

required_host_binding_setup: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo and RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup for pod-local Rust tools
b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu cargo +nightly-2026-04-03 run --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend --bin ds4-cuda-model-residency-smoke -- /workspace/ds4/ds4flash.gguf
